gaps: Small fishing boat or rowboat for Harbor: Poly Haven only has tall ships (dutch_ship_medium 69k tris, ship_pinnace 184k tris) and ambientCG has no boats. Fallback: use dutch_ship_medium (listed in visual.json, tier extra) as a moored backdrop, and build simple hulls textured with blue_painted_planks / weathered_planks, or take a CC0 boat from the model-library research.
Shipping container model for Railyard: none on Poly Haven. Fallback: 6.06 x 2.44 x 2.59 m boxes textured with container_side (tiles at 1.94 m) or ambientCG CorrugatedSteel007A, tinted per container.

Pallets, rail wagons, cranes, warehouse shell: no Poly Haven models. Fallback: block these out from primitives with the Railyard texture sets (weathered_brown_planks for pallets, Rails001 for track), or source CC0 models elsewhere.

Game-ready full-size pine trees: Poly Haven pine_tree_01 is 17.4M polys and fir_tree_01 7.8M, too heavy for WebGL. Fallback: decimate pine_sapling_small (398k tris for 3 saplings) to about 10-15k tris each and scale up, or build trunks from cylinders with pine_bark plus branch cards cut from the ambientCG PineNeedles001 atlas; let fog and the misty_pines HDRI carry the distant tree line.
Sea surface for Harbor: no water material on either site. Fallback: three.js Water/Water2 shader with a procedural or tiling normal map.
KTX2/Basis textures: neither site serves KTX2. Fallback: convert the JPGs with toktx or gltf-transform (uastc for normals, etc1s for albedo) when building quality tiers.
notes:
Licence: every item is CC0 (Poly Haven and ambientCG publish everything as CC0), so no attribution is required.
Verification: all 552 URLs in visual.json (269 returned here) were fetched on 2026-11-09 with a ranged GET of bytes 0-2047: HTTP 206, correct magic bytes, and Content-Range total equal to the size the API reports. A previous run had verified 528 of them; this run re-fetched all of those and added 24. A curl-style User-Agent also works on the file CDNs; api.polyhaven.com itself wants a User-Agent header. ambientCG links (ambientcg.com/get?file=...) redirect to acg-download.struffelproductions.com, so follow redirects.
This output lists the core set only. /Users/neel/Documents/GitHub/ironvale/docs/research/visual.json holds everything with extra fields (map, asset, resolution, tier, save_as, tile_size_m, source_page): tier core = the 269 items here, tier extra = 16 more texture sets, 3 alternative HDRIs and 6 more props (dutch_ship_medium, fir_sapling, moss_01, boulder_01, wooden_bucket_01, barrel_03), tier model-2k = 2k textures and glTF for every prop.
HDRIs: Harbor small_harbour_sunset, Pinewood misty_pines, Railyard freight_station. Alternatives in the file: venice_sunset, kloofendal_misty_morning_puresky, industrial_sunset_02_puresky. misty_pines and freight_station have scenery baked into the panorama; use the puresky alternatives if that clashes with level geometry.
Poly Haven texture sets are three JPGs each: diff (albedo, sRGB), nor_gl (OpenGL normal), arm (R = AO, G = roughness, B = metalness; feed the same texture to aoMap, roughnessMap and metalnessMap). 1k and 2k differ only by the resolution token in the URL. Source page is https://polyhaven.com/a/<asset>.
ambientCG sets come as one zip per resolution with Color, NormalGL, NormalDX, Roughness, AmbientOcclusion and Displacement JPGs (plus usdc/mtlx/blend files to discard). Source page is https://ambientcg.com/a/<AssetId>.
Poly Haven glTF is multi-file. Save the .gltf, put the .bin beside it and the textures in a textures/ subfolder with their original filenames. Every URI in each 1k glTF was parsed and matched against the listed files, none missing. The .bin is shared between resolutions and sits under a /gltf/4k/ or /gltf/8k/ path on the CDN, so do not rewrite that URL. For 2k props swap 1k for 2k in the .gltf and texture URLs.
Alpha: for cut-out materials (fern_02, grass_medium_01, pine_sapling_small twigs, chain-link wire) the glTF points at an opaque JPG albedo, so the listed alpha-mask PNG has to be applied as alphaMap with alphaTest, or merged into the albedo when converting to GLB/KTX2.
Mesh weight: these are scans, not game meshes. modular_wooden_pier (85k tris), modular_chainlink_fence (89k), dead_tree_trunk (102k), rock_moss_set_01 (63k for 6 rocks), tree_stump_01 (41k) and pine_sapling_small (398k) need gltf-transform simplify / meshopt and instancing before they go in a map. Triangle counts are in the notes of each glTF item.
Ground cover for Pinewood: grass_medium_01 (17 grass clumps) and fern_02 models for instanced scatter, with ambientCG Grass004 and Ground037 as terrain materials.
visual.json was written from the sandbox rather than the Write tool because of its size.
